test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: World-famous Chhattisgarhi folk singer Teejan Bai is an exponent of what type of folk music?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandavani.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Teejan Bai** is an exponent of **Pandavani,** a traditional performing art form, from** Chhattisgarh.**
 
• In this art form, the actors narrate** tales from the Mahabharata, **with musical accompaniments.
 
• In this story,** Bhima,** the second eldest son of Pandava is the** hero. **
 
• This art form is famous in the neighbouring areas of** Madhya Pradesh, Orissa, and Andhra Pradesh as well.**
 
• **Jhaduram Devangan **and **Ritu Verma** are also associated with this art form. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gondhal** is a famous musical art form of Maharashtra. Lallati Bhandar is a hit Gondhal song from the movie Jogwa, sung by Ajay Gogavale.
 
• **Lavani** is a genre of music popular in Maharashtra. Some of the notable artists of this art form are Kantabai Satarkar, Surekha Punekar, Mangala Bansode, Sandhya Mane, etc.
 
• **Bharud** is a very old poetic form that was used by 16th-century poets like Eknath to compose devotional songs. It is one of the important folk arts of Maharashtra.
